employees.evidence: This leaves us needing to treat them fairly and in the manner that we would wish to be treated if our positions were reversed.

shareholders.evidence: Our long-term economic goal is to maximize Berkshire’s average annual rate of gain in intrinsic business value on a per-share basis.

integrity.evidence: We will be candid in our reporting to you, emphasizing the pluses and minuses important in appraising business value.

result.analyst_notes: Written in first person by Buffett and Munger as owner-partners, the tone is reflective and explanatory rather than promotional. Shareholders are addressed first and most often, with candor and transparency repeated. Commitments mix hedged phrasing (we will try, we expect) with absolute ones (we will never, we will not). Distinctive wording includes eat our own cooking and gin rummy managerial behavior.
